svg.aria-label: WalkieTalkey: Danish speech to text on your own machine
svg.title: WalkieTalkey: Danish speech to text on your own machine
svg.text: Hold fn, talk, let go: the text lands where you are typing. Or
talk into your phone and it lands on your computer,
encrypted end to end. Free, local, no accounts.

g.text: Kan du deploye det til prod
Filler words out, self-corrections applied, dev terms spelled right.
